_comment: Tests Sydney Spine's mandatory new/existing gate, the existing patient sub-type question (maintenance vs longer), and the multi-location disambiguation block for city/Double Bay callers.

scenarios.name: New patient — silent confirm_service after gate answer

history.content: I'd like to book a chiropractic appointment.
Have you had chiropractic care with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently with appointment_type='First Appointment', appointment_type_id='1546179571135554851', patient_status='new'. FAIL if agent speaks any text before the tool call, asks any follow-up question, or uses a wrong appointment type ID.

scenarios.name: Existing patient — must ask maintenance vs longer before routing

history.content: I need to book an appointment.
Have you had chiropractic care with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Are you coming in for a maintenance visit or a longer appointment?' as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent routes to either appointment type without asking the disambiguation question.

scenarios.name: City clinic caller — redirect and offer Pagewood only

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book at your city clinic please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the redirect message directing caller to book online at sydney spine dot com dot au for city/Double Bay, and asks if they'd like to book at Pagewood instead. FAIL if agent attempts to route to a chiro service at the city location or routes to info_pivot without the redirect message.

scenarios.name: Acupuncture new patient — gate fires, routes to Acupuncture New Clients

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment.
Have you had acupuncture with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently with appointment_type='Acupuncture New Clients', appointment_type_id='2029565117741409914', patient_status='new', practitioner_preference='Jaqueline Barnett'. FAIL if agent routes to a chiropractic appointment type (e.g. 'First Appointment'), omits practitioner_preference, or asks a further question.

scenarios.name: Acupuncture returning patient — gate answer must NOT fall through to CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH

history.content: I'd like to book acupuncture please.
Have you had acupuncture with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently with appointment_type='Acupuncture Subsequent visit', appointment_type_id='2029567164872140411', patient_status='existing', practitioner_preference='Jaqueline Barnett'. FAIL if agent instead asks 'maintenance visit or a longer appointment' (the CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH's existing-patient question) or routes to Long Appointment/Maintenance visit — this is the regression the SCAN C rewrite specifically guards against, since a bare affirmative to a patient-history gate previously always routed to CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH regardless of which service's gate question was actually asked.

scenarios.name: Arvigo Abdominal Therapy — direct route, no gate question

history.content: Can I book in for Arvigo abdominal therapy?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type='Arvigo Abdominal Therapy', appointment_type_id='2029568435444262524', practitioner_preference='Jaqueline Barnett' — with no new/returning gate question asked first. FAIL if agent asks 'have you had this with us before?' or any gate question, or routes to a chiropractic type.

scenarios.name: Chiropractor named, no service — Andrew (single-category) routes to CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH gate

history.content: Can I book in with Andrew?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH STEP 1 gate question (e.g. "Have you had chiropractic care with us before?" or an approved variant) with zero tool call, and stores practitioner_preference = "Andrew McHardy". FAIL if agent lists Andrew's services, asks an open-ended "what service?" question, calls confirm_service directly, or fails to capture practitioner_preference.

scenarios.name: Jaqueline named, no service — multi-category practitioner asks Acupuncture vs Arvigo sub-type
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks a sub-type question offering Acupuncture and Arvigo Abdominal Therapy (e.g. "Jaqueline offers Acupuncture and Arvigo Abdominal Therapy. Which were you after?") with zero tool call, and stores practitioner_preference = "Jaqueline Barnett". FAIL if agent defaults to only one of her services without asking, routes into the CHIROPRACTIC BRANCH, or calls confirm_service before the sub-type is resolved.

scenarios.name: Jaqueline sub-type answered 'acupuncture' — routes to ACUPUNCTURE branch gate question, not direct booking

history.content: Jaqueline offers Acupuncture and Arvigo Abdominal Therapy. Which were you after?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the ACUPUNCTURE branch's own gate question ("Have you had acupuncture with us before?" or the OTHER variant) with zero tool call. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service immediately without asking the gate question, or routes to Arvigo Abdominal Therapy instead.
